# Paths grcov must drop from the coverage report entirely.
#
# One glob per line; `#` comments and blank lines are ignored. Patterns use
# globset syntax (brace alternates supported), matched against paths relative to
# the repository root.
#
# Consumed by:
#   - .github/actions/run-tests/action.yml  (turned into `grcov --ignore` flags)
#   - contrib/tools/grcov-excl              (to know which files it must police)
#
# Test code that lives *inside* a non-ignored file is handled separately, by the
# GRCOV_EXCL_START / GRCOV_EXCL_STOP markers that grcov-excl maintains.

# Outside the source tree
../*
/*

# Non-source directories
.github/**
.vscode/**
changelog.d/**
contrib/**
**/.cargo/**

# Test and benchmark code.
#
# Spell the singular and plural forms out. globset drops the empty branch of a
# brace alternate, so the `**/test{,s}/**` these replaced matched `tests/` but
# never `test/`, and likewise for `test.rs` and `*_test.rs`.
**/benches/**
**/examples/**
**/test/**
**/tests/**
**/test.rs
**/tests.rs
**/*_test.rs
**/*_tests.rs

# Non-Rust files
**/*.clar
**/*.json
**/*.md
**/*.sha256
**/*.snap
**/*.toml
**/*.txt
**/*.yml
